rule: Every sentence, heading or list item in scope that mentions an action term must exactly match a registered clause. Every clause must be PROHIBITED, must carry exactly one negation (its own, or for list items its lead-in's) and must contain no permissive or exception wording.
scope: Every normative document: root *.md files and docs/*.md. Reports under reports/ are historical evidence and are not normative.
